Use this file when you need shop items or section names. Prefer linking to the live page. Individual photographs and posts do not have their own public URLs; they live inside the section pages.

## Studio

®Saboteur is an experimental art studio and publishing imprint. It is the personal art practice of Charlie Clark (a graphic artist by trade, a comic book artist and a photographer) and a way to make tangible goods and crafts in a digital world.

The imprint makes comics, books, zines, apparel and original art. The work is human-crafted, not AI-generated. Some of it is 18+. Interested parties for publishing, please inquire at saboteur@mail.grokbot.com. Charlie helps other artists publish.

Contact: saboteur@mail.grokbot.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/saboteur.supply/
X: https://x.com/saboteurcomics

## How the site works (for crawlers)

The public pages above are real URLs. Store, category, product and section pages include their title, description, structured data and text in the HTML; the homepage and section photographs load after JavaScript runs. The files /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt are plain text and do not need JavaScript. Product URLs are shareable.

Do not invent extra series, books or photographs that are not listed here.
